name: Tenant context required
rule: All authenticated business requests carry resolved tenant context.

name: Secrets
rule: No production secrets in source/config repositories.

name: Encryption
rule: TLS in transit; protected data encryption at rest through approved platform controls.

name: Audit
rule: Privileged/admin/security/financial/AI approval actions generate audit records.

name: Dependency security
rule: Dependencies and containers are scanned before promotion.

name: SAST/secret scan
rule: Source changes pass static and secret scanning.

name: Session/token policy
rule: Token/session lifetimes and revocation follow approved identity policy.

name: File safety
rule: Uploads are validated/scanned and served with permission checks.

name: Rate limiting
rule: Sensitive/public integration endpoints support throttling/abuse controls.

name: Break glass
rule: Emergency privileged access is time-bound, logged and reviewed.
